categories.question: You have enough for one souvenir at a natural history museum. What comes home with you?

outcomes.name: A fossil rubbing kit
outcomes.description: Small paper pack with a trilobite relief, blank sheet and two wax rubbing sticks

outcomes.name: A bird-call whistle
outcomes.description: Small carved wooden bird-shaped whistle on a simple cord

outcomes.name: A meteorite postcard
outcomes.description: Illustrated postcard of a fiery meteor over desert hills, without writing

outcomes.name: A pocket magnifier necklace
outcomes.description: Round brass magnifying lens on a long dark leather cord
